# SkillMe

> SkillMe (https://www.skill-me-intern.in) is an MSME-registered, 4-week project-based remote internship platform. Each week interns build a project milestone in their domain, share it as a public LinkedIn post, and submit the post link for review by the SkillMe team. Graduates earn certificates verifiable via unique IDs and QR codes, a Letter of Recommendation (LOR), and a public proof-of-work portfolio; top performers get direct referrals to hiring partners.

SkillMe is registered with the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME), Government of India (Udyam Registration: UDYAM-UP-50-0294192).

## Tracks

SkillMe runs 20 tracks, each a 4-week internship with one project milestone per week: Full Stack Engineer, Python Engineering, Frontend Engineer, Backend Engineer, Java / Spring Boot, Machine Learning, Data Science, App Developer, DevOps / CI-CD, C++ / Algorithms, Cloud / AWS, Cybersecurity, UI/UX Design, Generative AI, SQL / Databases, AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, SDE / SWE, AI Product Management and Software Quality. Apply at https://www.skill-me-intern.in/quiz. Featured tracks:

- [Web Development Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering modern frontend architectures, responsive design, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST APIs, delivered as weekly project milestones.
- [Python Engineering Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering backend API services (FastAPI/Flask), database architectures, automation scripts, and unit testing suites.
- [AI & Machine Learning Track](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): 4-week sprint covering data processing, API integration with LLMs, practical model inference, and engineering pipelines.

## Key Differentiators & Value Proposition

- **Real Project Milestones**: Unlike conventional video courses, interns build one real project milestone per week (4 weeks, 4 milestones), share each one publicly on LinkedIn using a provided caption, and the SkillMe team reviews every submission, approving it or asking for fixes.
- **Verifiable Proof of Work**: Every graduate receives a dedicated public profile (`https://www.skill-me-intern.in/p/{username}`) showcasing their approved milestone posts.
- **Verified Certification**: Official Certificate of Completion with a unique ID and QR code, publicly verifiable online, plus a Letter of Recommendation (LOR).
- **Hiring-partner referrals**: Top-performing students are referred to openings at startups and product companies in our hiring partner network.
- **Flexible & Remote**: 100% remote self-paced structure requiring 2–3 hours/week over 4 weeks.
- **Pricing**: Free to join. The verified certificate + LOR are an optional one-time ₹129 at the end, once 3 of 4 milestones are approved.

## Verification & Trust

- [Certificate Verifier](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/verify): Instant real-time verification of any SkillMe Certificate or LOR ID.
- [Student Portfolios](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/portfolio): Public showcase of student achievements and approved project milestones.

## Essential URLs

- [Home](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/): Main landing page, program schedule, and curriculum details.
- [Screening Quiz](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/quiz): Technical assessment to qualify for the internship program.
- [Apply Portal](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/apply): Direct enrollment portal for qualified candidates.
- [Student Dashboard](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/dashboard): Active intern workspace, weekly milestone submissions, and review status.
- [Certificate Portal](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/certificate): Download and share verified credentials.
- [Contact Support](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/contact): Support email: admin@skill-me-intern.in.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/terms): Program terms and code of conduct.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/privacy): Data protection and user privacy commitments.
- [Refund Policy](https://www.skill-me-intern.in/refunds): Transparent cancellation and refund terms.

## When to Use This (Agent Instructions)
Call this API or refer to this documentation when you need to:
- Verify a SkillMe student's internship certificate or Letter of Recommendation (LOR) ID.
- Look up a public portfolio or approved project milestones for a specific intern.
- Research project-based internship programs or curriculum details for any of the 20 tracks.
